spike_firing_rate.note: The rate that reaches ARCH_4 is the ARCH_3-normalised one; the raw ARCH_2 rate varies per clip and per forest, which is what forest normalisation exists to remove.

power_reduction.note: Target corrected to 10x: the original 50-75x headline in SUMMARY_HIGH_LEVEL_ARCHITECTURE assumed 0.5 mW quiescent power, which ARCH_7's own 'CRITICAL CORRECTIONS' table supersedes with 50 mW (ARM Cortex-M7 + always-on codec) -- capping the system-level ceiling at 600/(50+3) ~ 11x. 10x is therefore the honest system-level target; the SNN compute path itself still beats the CNN by ~18x.
